_doc: SSOT for Helix ecosystem ports. Every component's port lives HERE and nowhere else.
_rules: A listening address that is MISSING is fail-closed: throw (the service must not start on a guessed port).
An OUTBOUND endpoint that is MISSING throws OR explicitly degrades to a declared 'absent' state (never a silent default).
scheme MUST match the real protocol (a scheme that lies is the same fault family as a configured value standing in for a measured one).
